label: ASRS v1.1 (Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale)
summary: 18-item WHO-developed screener. Part A (6 items, cutoff ≥4) determines the screen; Part B (12 items) characterises symptom load. Deliberately tuned for sensitivity, so a positive screen is a reason to evaluate, not a diagnosis.

label: Cognitive Trade-off Task (ASRT + Go/No-Go)
summary: The paradigm used by Horváth et al. 2026: an Alternating Serial Reaction Time Task carrying a hidden probabilistic sequence (statistical learning) with an embedded Go/No-Go component (response inhibition), so both are measured at once rather than in isolation.
